# llms-full.txt for Pluto Associates
# https://plutoassociates.com

## Entity
Pluto Associates, Advocates & Legal Consultants (est. 2003), Kathmandu, Nepal. Provides full-service legal advice with emphasis on corporate, foreign investment, regulatory, and dispute matters.

## Detailed Services
Corporate & Business: company incorporation, joint ventures, M&A, corporate governance, contracts, compliance.
FDI: investment approvals, sectoral clearances, project structuring, repatriation.
Energy: hydropower, PPAs, licensing, BOOT/IPP.
Litigation: civil/commercial/criminal, ADR/arbitration.
IP: trademarks/patents/copyright, enforcement.
Tax/Labor/Real Estate/NGO/Family/International clients.
